model_annotation: The chart displays the distribution of the target token prediction probability during the MuST-C English-German training process. The x-axis is labeled "迭代次数" (iteration count), with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 in intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "目标端概率分布不一致程度" (degree of inconsistency in target-side probability distribution), with a linear scale from 0 to 1.2 in intervals of 0.2. The chart contains two lines: a blue line representing "语音增强前" (before speech enhancement), marked with a solid line style, and an orange line representing "语音增强后" (after speech enhancement), also marked with a solid line style. The blue line starts at approximately 1.1 on the y-axis at x=0, decreases sharply to around 0.55 at x=5, and then gradually declines to about 0.5 at x=30. The orange line begins at roughly 0.9 on the y-axis at x=0, drops to approximately 0.45 at x=5, and continues to decrease gradually to around 0.45 at x=30.
